intro: Hi! I'm Boba Mouse. 🧋 Pack your bags — today we are going to Norway! 挪威！

items.example: In Norway, the sun is still up at midnight in summer.
The sun moves in a circle and never goes down.
People close the curtains because it is too bright.

task: 用 because 改写：It is bright at midnight. People close the curtains. → 两句合成一句！
